subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled Control UI code-editor dependency for raw JSON5 config editing, and should that happen by repairing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75466 or by asking for a fresh narrower PR?
rationale: The feature fits web frontend ergonomics, but it changes a sensitive config editing surface and adds a meaningful UI dependency, so maintainer product and compatibility intent should decide the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the PR is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and save/apply behavior, and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Keep the textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency/product surface until raw config editing becomes a higher priority or a lighter existing component is chosen.

options.title: Require a design note first
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a short maintainer note comparing dependency choice, JSON5 formatting semantics, and sensitive-value handling before more code work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the PR is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and save/apply behavior, and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is tied by history to the sensitive raw config reveal-to-edit behavior and related tests that define the compatibility boundary for this decision.
